name: std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator::options
intro:
Returns the options that affect the directory iteration. The options can only be supplied when constructing the directory iterator.

If the options argument was not supplied, returns std::filesystem::directory_options::none.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The effective options that affect the directory iteration.

summary: Returns the options that affect the directory iteration. The options can only be supplied when constructing the directory iterator.

recommendedExamples.output:
Print dir structure using OS specific command 'tree':
sandbox
├── a
│   └── b
├── file1.txt
└── syma -> a
 
Print dir structure using directory iterator:
"sandbox/syma"
"sandbox/file1.txt"
"sandbox/a"
"sandbox/a/b"
